protocol.design: One fresh attempt for each of three first-upgrade contracts per model after the 4/5 ordinary gate; one fresh second extension per fully accepted parent. Standard production adapter; no call-ID rewriting. No operator repairs or promotions. All candidate execution in disposable VMs.
protocol.settings: 128K context, 4K responses, 128 actions, 65536 generated tokens, 30-minute upgrade deadline, 900-second request timeout. Nonthinking, temperature .6 (.7 and presence penalty1.5 for Bonsai). Q8 KV except Bonsai Q4 KV. All profiles use verified PrismML runtime; this differs from older Ollama Qwen studies.
protocol.oxcoder_selection: Before capability trials compare Q4/Q5/Q6 at identical 128K Q8 KV. Select highest precision with coherent benchmark calls, exact requested context, all layers on GPU, and <=2x Q4 benchmark wall time. Preserve every preflight. If none qualify, record infrastructure limitation.
protocol.scope: Exploratory screen, one sample per contract. Not a repeatability study, causal seed comparison, or model ranking. No new default settings.
